title: Foods from around the world
examples: Where did rice originally come from?
Can you name a spice that comes from an animal?
What is a staple food for people in Africa?

explain.say: Today we explore foods from all over the world. We will learn where different foods originally grew.
Some foods need special plants to grow well. These are called staple foods for many people.
Spices are dried parts of plants that add flavour. They make food taste exciting and special.
For example, cinnamon comes from the bark of a tree. It gives a sweet, warm taste.
Another example is cumin. This spice comes from the seeds of a small plant.
A real life example is making curry. You use spices like turmeric and cumin with staple foods like rice.

faq.a: Most spices come from plants, but some flavourings can come from other sources too. It is best to check the packaging.
asks: Do spices always come from plants?
What are the sources of flavouring?

faq.q: What makes a food a staple food?
faq.a: A staple food is a basic, reliable food source that many people rely on daily. It forms the main part of the diet.
asks: What is the main food source for a culture?
Why are some foods called staple?

faq.q: Where did chocolate originally come from?
faq.a: Chocolate actually comes from beans that grow in tropical regions. These beans are then processed into chocolate.
asks: What is the origin of cocoa?

faq.q: Can I use spices in baking?
faq.a: Yes, you can use many spices in baking. Cinnamon and nutmeg are very popular additions to cakes and breads.
asks: Are spices only for savoury food?
What spices taste good in sweet things?

faq.q: Does the origin of a food change its taste?
faq.a: The origin tells us where it started, but how it is cooked changes the taste. Cooking methods are very important.
asks: Does where something grows affect taste?
Is taste only about the ingredients?

facts: Rice is a staple food for many people in Asia.
Spices are dried parts of plants used for flavour.
Tomatoes are native to the Americas.
Maize, or corn, is a staple crop from the Americas.

quiz.say: If a culture relies heavily on yams for energy, what is yam considered?
quiz.why: A staple food is the main, reliable source of energy for a population.

wrong.1: Spices are used for flavour, not the main source of energy.
wrong.2: While yams are roots, this term describes the plant part, not its role in the diet.
wrong.3: This term describes what spices do, not the main food source.

quiz.say: Which of these items is a spice that comes from a seed?
quiz.why: Cumin is specifically known to come from the seeds of a plant.

wrong.0: Cinnamon comes from the bark of a tree, not the seed.
wrong.1: Tomatoes are a fruit/vegetable, not classified as a spice.
wrong.2: Rice is a grain, which is a staple food, not a spice.

quiz.say: If a food's origin is the Americas, which of these is likely to be true?
quiz.why: The lesson taught that maize is a food that originated in the Americas.

wrong.1: Rice is taught to have originated in Asia.
wrong.2: Cinnamon is from tree bark, and its origin is not specified as the Americas.
wrong.3: Cumin is a spice, but its taught origin is not the Americas.
